_comment: The Wend valley (MAP-6, Milestone 9): the hand-written core of the map that carries Fair in Wend now and The Lair of Arachas later. Our own text, CC-BY-4.0, credit 'nat20-table contributors'. Places from lore/the_wend_valley.md and the Milestone 9 spec. A pack does not draw the map: it names the pack_slot it fills. Places with discovered false, roads to them and the edges are DM data only. Distances in miles; terrain and good roads set the maximum pace (SRD 5.2.1, Travel Terrain, Good Roads). A place's scene comes from the pack, so none is set here: travel loads the campaign's road scene until a pack names one. Inn prices are room and board per person per night, from the SRD 5.1 lodging and meal prices (a 2014 fill under Rule 7).

places._comment: The fair town at the river's mouth, two days downriver from Wendford. Salt, iron and cloth.
places.name: Saltmouth

places._comment: Forty households where the old road crosses the river. Flour and ale; a room over the alehouse.
places.name: Wendford

places._comment: Where the river road crosses the Millbeck, twelve miles below Wendford: a footbridge, a willow hut and a ford upstream. A stop on the road, not a market; its stretch of road is the Millbeck zone, which holds only the toll card (B8).
places.name: The Millbeck bridge

places._comment: A market village halfway down the river road, fourteen miles above Saltmouth: a market on fair days and an inn, the Halfway, where the wagons going down to the fair stop for the night.
places.name: Midwend

places._comment: A mile upriver at the end of a hedged lane. The Silent Mill.
places.name: Pell's mill

places._comment: Upland farms on the slopes under the Hollin Hills. Wool, honey and peat.
places.name: The Highsteads

places._comment: A hungry hill band's camp, herding sheep for food. Barter with the hills. Its name tells nobody's fate: after the Mill's yard_to_the_end there is no Snitt (MAP-20).
places.name: Goblin camp

places._comment: A hollow oak on a barrow at the valley's eastern edge. The Lair of Arachas.
places.name: The Barrow Oak

places._comment: The salt flats across the old channel, south of Saltmouth: the road runs six miles to the old ferry landing, and the flats are crossed on foot at low tide (lore, The old channel). A free slot for the next pack.
places.name: The salt flats

roads._comment: The river road's upper stretch, Wendford down to the Millbeck bridge: its own zone, for the toll at the bridge alone.
The river road from the Millbeck bridge to Midwend.
The river road from Midwend to the fair. With the two stretches above it, forty miles from Wendford: two days with a wagon at a normal pace.

edges._comment: The caravans' road: the generated road to a far city leaves here. Closed in Milestone 9. Its id predates the turn of the map (decision 0102): the road runs north.
edges.name: the old road north

edges._comment: Closed in Milestone 9. Its id predates the turn of the map (decision 0102): the road runs south.
edges.name: the old road south
